must_satisfy.statement: The allowed notification must traverse the real durable notification and Outbox state machine.

must_not.statement: No external notification provider may be called.

acceptable_variations: SMTP may be the single external destination emulated by the recording sink.
critical_failures: Injecting a simulated receipt into the model-visible tool observation.
adjudication_note: Engineering-chain oracle only; it is never model-visible.
